basis: Douglas Dynamics publicly established the threshold crossing on October 28, 2024. Consolidated GAAP net sales for the three months ended September 30 were $129,398,000 in 2024 and $144,121,000 in 2023. Sales fell 10.22% and came in $7,516,950 below the $136,914,950 cutoff. The earliest disclosure date remains unresolved. I located document-specific archive entries for both the May and September 2024 investor presentations, but could not verify either deck’s contents or original publication date. The upper_bound field records the October 28 actual.

coverage.detail: Reopened Exhibit 99.1 and the issuer release. Both consolidated income statements give 129,398 and 144,121 in thousands in the three-month columns. The adjacent 424,955 and 433,933 are nine-month sales. Work Truck Attachments and Work Truck Solutions are included in both comparative quarters.
The January 30 preliminary results covered Q4 and full-year 2023. The initial 2024 outlook discussed adjusted EPS growth.
The February 26 release projected $600 million to $660 million of full-year 2024 net sales. It gave no Q3 consolidated ceiling.
The issuer’s April 23 annual shareholder meeting page links to this webcast. The host returned a cache miss, leaving the spoken remarks unverified.
The April 29 Q1 release lowered full-year sales guidance to $600 million–$640 million. The separate growth percentages were long-term segment targets.

The issuer-linked April 30 Q1 webcast returned a cache miss. The secondary call transcript discusses the annual guidance reduction and provides no explicit consolidated Q3 sales ceiling. https://www.roic.ai/quote/PLOW/transcripts/2024-year/1-quarter

The July 29 Q2 release maintained full-year sales guidance of $600 million–$640 million. Subtracting first-half actual sales of $295.557 million implies $304.443 million–$344.443 million for Q3 and Q4 combined. The release gave no separate consolidated Q3 upper bound.

The issuer-linked July 30 Q2 webcast returned a cache miss. In the secondary transcript, management’s approximately 65/35 Q2/Q3 split applied to Attachments preseason shipments. Its Q3 margin discussion concerned adjusted EBITDA. Neither quantified consolidated Q3 sales. https://www.marketbeat.com/earnings/reports/2024-7-29-douglas-dynamics-inc-stock/
The supplemental PDF linked from the secondary call archive was inaccessible both at this URL and with the query string removed.

Stock Analysis lists investor slides on May 8 and September 20, 2024. TradingView lists both dates as well. Neither listing supplied readable slides or established when the issuer first published them. https://www.tradingview.com/symbols/NYSE-PLOW/documents/

This additional archive exposed distinct links for the May and September 2024 decks. Both direct requests returned cache misses. Searches using the filenames did not recover readable issuer copies. May: https://www.presentationnation.com/company/douglas-dynamics/plowinvestorpresentationmay2024final September: https://www.presentationnation.com/company/douglas-dynamics/plowinvestorpresentationsept2024

The visible issuer deck archive reaches back to May 2025. The September 2024 historical lookup was inaccessible at https://web.archive.org/web/20240930/https://ir.douglasdynamics.com/news-events/presentations. The issuer calendar lists the April, July and October earnings calls but identifies no host for either deck. https://ir.douglasdynamics.com/news-events/ir-calendar/past

Sidoti’s September 18–19 conference schedule contains no Douglas Dynamics entry. Its recording directory was inaccessible. I could not tie either presentation to this host. Schedule: https://s24.q4cdn.com/538403808/files/doc_news/Sidoti-Events-LLCs-Virtual-September-Small-Cap-Conference-2024.pdf Recordings: https://www.meetmax.com/sched/event_109663/conference_presentations.html?bank_access=0&event_id=109663

The similarly dated September 20 SEC filing expressly identifies its Exhibit 99.1 as an investor presentation dated September 18, 2023. This resolves the year of that exhibit and leaves the September 2024 deck outstanding.

The interim issuer releases covered the September 5 dividend, September 11 property transaction and September 17 management changes. The September 3 Form 8-K reported a $300,000 restricted-stock-unit award, and the September 18 Form 8-K reported officer changes. Neither filing provided a Q3 sales estimate. https://ir.douglasdynamics.com/sec-filings/all-sec-filings/content/0001437749-24-028243/0001437749-24-028243.pdf and https://ir.douglasdynamics.com/sec-filings/all-sec-filings/content/0001437749-24-029471/0001437749-24-029471.pdf

The September 11 sale-leaseback raised $64.2 million from operating properties. The Q3 income statement recorded the $42.298 million gain separately below gross profit, preserving the reported net-sales comparison.
The October 15 notice scheduled results for after market close October 28 and the call for October 29. It disclosed no preliminary sales figure.

publication_date_evidence: The issuer’s archive timestamps the Q3 results release October 28, 2024 at 6:05 p.m. EDT. Exhibit 99.1 carries the same October 28 dateline. The October 29 call and Form 10-Q followed. This verifies public availability of the actual on October 28. The earlier presentation listings establish neither what management disclosed nor when the decks first became public. https://ir.douglasdynamics.com/news-events/press-releases?page=3
